title: How Bias Binds: Measuring Hidden Associations for Bias Control in Text-to-Image Compositions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image generated outputs using prompts from the Winobias benchmark, which pairs occupational roles with compositional attributes and objects (e.g., colored hats, briefcases). The evaluation uses a Bias Adherence Score based on cosine similarity to male and female prototype embeddings extracted via a CLIP encoder, and computes Fairness Discrepancy (FD) to measure gender representation imbalances.
